title: Eggs & Berries
description: New foods and recepies using eggs and berries, because I got tired of not being able to fry eggs in minecraft!
body:
![Eggs & Berries title card!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ca6e501d3827855b00539b1844b8138f51e09a79.png)

Welcome to Eggs and Berries: Vanilla Foods, a mod inspired by the lack of simple and quick emergency recipes on the go!

This mod aims to make those extra eggs, collected sweet (and glow) berries, and even mushrooms from your travels into better foods, with some of them providing helpful effects for exploration and combat.
The foods added in this mod very much imitate the functions of vanilla foods, only using vanilla ingredients and blocks (like furnaces, smokers, campfires, and crafting tables) to cook, to ease accessibility and inclusion in vanilla+ servers and modpacks.

Every new added recepie can be accessed through Minecraft's built-in recepie book.


![Known Issues handle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2e1604e3b1800a0f47497315b838f55c9e292846.png)

In case of any bugs and issues, please use the form provided!
